title: Tech Note: [3rd Party Tech Note] Using a Custom Component to Patch Deployed Data Files
author: Cam Adams, Justin Carr, and David Adams

historical_commentary.text: This third-party note's core architectural pattern — packaging patch logic as a versioned 4D component that can safely modify field-level data in deployed customer databases without a full rebuild — remains a valid and still-used technique for supporting deployed 4D applications, though today it would more likely be built with 4D classes/modules under Project Mode and ORDA data access rather than classic components and embedded SQL.
related_updates: Project Mode (v17+) changed how components/modules are packaged and versioned
ORDA-based data access has largely replaced embedded SQL as the preferred way to read/write records in new code, though SQL remains supported
